description: This file implements the RDKWindowManager functionality, including display creation, input handling, key intercepts, event dispatching, and lifecycle management for the RDK window manager component.

classes.name: CreateDisplayRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to create a display, including client info, display parameters, and synchronization semaphore.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the window manager functionalities, including display management, input handling, event dispatching, and lifecycle control.

methods.name: getKeyFlag
methods.description: Converts a modifier string ('ctrl', 'shift', 'alt') into corresponding key flags.

methods.name: lockRdkWindowManagerMutex
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the global window manager mutex with a timeout fallback.

methods.name: isClientExists
methods.description: Checks if a client already has a display request or exists in the current display requests or client list.

methods.name: toLower
methods.description: Converts a client name string to lowercase.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager, sets environment variables, starts the main thread loop, and registers event listeners.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops threads, unregisters listeners, and resets the singleton instance.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display based on JSON parameters, manages display requests, and adds listeners.

methods.name: GetClients
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current clients as a JSON string.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercept
methods.description: Adds a key intercept for a client, blocking specific key events.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Adds multiple key intercepts from a JSON array.

methods.name: RemoveKeyIntercept
methods.description: Removes a key intercept for a client.

methods.name: AddKeyListener
methods.description: Adds key event listeners for a client.

methods.name: RemoveKeyListener
methods.description: Removes key event listeners for a client.

methods.name: InjectKey
methods.description: Simulates a key press event programmatically.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Simulates multiple key events for a client.

methods.name: EnableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Enables or disables user inactivity reporting.

methods.name: SetInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the inactivity timeout interval.

methods.name: ResetInactivityTime
methods.description: Resets the inactivity timer.

methods.name: EnableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeat functionality.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: IgnoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Sets whether key inputs should be ignored.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables or disables input events for specified clients.

methods.name: KeyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Configures key repeat settings such as enabled, initial delay, and repeat interval.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Internal method to handle display creation requests, ensuring client uniqueness and listener registration.

methods.name: setInactivityInterval
methods.description: Internal method to set inactivity timeout.

methods.name: resetInactivityTime
methods.description: Internal method to reset inactivity timer.
